report.explanation: Current read-only telemetry shows healthy checkout: gateway and order traces OK at 60ms, error rate 0.0014, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause. The order deployment record (3.2.8, 1466 min old) cannot establish latency causation. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Telemetry demonstrating the degraded checkout health asserted by the alert (error/latency spike)
Per-dependency latency and timeout breakdown for order's downstreams (inventory, payment, postgresql)
Time-series metrics showing onset and trend of degradation rather than a single healthy window
Evidence of resource saturation (db pool, redis) or configuration change correlated with the alert
